audience: teams that message customers on WhatsApp through Zoko

useCases.title: Find customers by tag
useCases.text: List the customers. Then read the tags of each one to find a tag such as VIP.

useCases.title: Check a message delivery
useCases.text: Read a sent message and its delivery history: sent, delivered, read or failed.

useCases.title: Send a WhatsApp template
useCases.text: List the approved templates with their placeholders. Then send one to a customer who consented.

useCases.title: Look up agents and teams
useCases.text: List the agents and the teams on the account, for routing questions.
